R20.title: DUPLICATE SERIAL / IDENTICAL DEVICE COLLISION
R20.justification: Canonical §262 requires two identical devices (duplicate serial or no-serial collision). This bench has exactly one supported DAC, and its identity is topology-derived from the unique port chain 3-3.3.2, so no collision pair can be formed. Not a silent skip: no second device was present.

R21.title: PASSIVE CLAIM VS EXACT OPEN CONSISTENCY
R21.evidence: passive advertisement exposes S32_LE only; exact opens succeed on the advertised carrier and are truthfully refused for S16_LE tuples

R22.title: SIGNIFICANT-BIT DEPTH CONSISTENCY
R22.evidence: 12 physical rows: 16-bit sources -> container adapted; 24-bit sources -> exact carrier. Decoder reported S24LE, closed with the real pair table; real width rewrite still classifies DSP

R23.title: MULTI-ENDPOINT / COMPOSITE USB AUDIO
R23.justification: Canonical §265 targets composite/multi-endpoint USB audio devices. The SMSL 152a:85dd exposes a single PCM endpoint (usb-interface:1.0:pcm:0:sub:0), so there are no sibling endpoints to exercise on this hardware.
